ayahs.1: Alif Laam Ra. Yeh pur-hikmat kitaab ki aayaten hain.
ayahs.2: Kya in logon ko is baat se taajjub hua ke hum ne un mein se ek shakhs ke paas wahi bhej di ke sab aadmiyon ko daraiye aur jo imaan le aaye un ko yeh khushkhabri sunaiye ke un ke Rabb ke paas un ko poora ajr-o-martaba milega. Kaafiron ne kaha ke yeh shakhs to bila-shubha sareeh jadugar hai.
ayahs.3: Bila-shubha tumhara Rabb Allah hi hai jis ne aasmanon aur zameen ko chhe roz mein paida kar diya phir arsh par qaayim hua woh har kaam ki tadbeer karta hai. Us ki ijazat ke baghair koi us ke paas sifarish karne wala nahi aisa Allah tumhara Rabb hai so tum us ki ibaadat karo, kya tum phir bhi naseehat nahi pakadte.
ayahs.4: Tum sab ko Allah hi ke paas jana hai, Allah ne sachcha wada kar rakha hai. Be-shak wahi pehli baar bhi paida karta hai phir wahi dobara bhi paida karega taake aise logon ko jo ke imaan laaye aur unhon ne nek kaam kiye insaf ke saath jaza de aur jin logon ne kufr kiya un ke waste khaulta hua paani peene ko milega aur dardnaak azaab hoga un ke kufr ki wajah se.
ayahs.5: Woh Allah Taala aisa hai jis ne aftab ko chamakta hua banaya aur chaand ko noorani banaya aur us ke liye manzilen muqarrar keen taake tum barson ki ginti aur hisab maloom kar liya karo. Allah Taala ne yeh cheezen be-faaida nahi paida keen. Woh yeh dalail un ko saaf saaf batla raha hai jo danish rakhte hain.
ayahs.6: Bila-shubha raat aur din ke yake baad deegare aane mein aur Allah Taala ne jo kuch aasmanon aur zameen mein paida kiya hai un sab mein un logon ke waste dalail hain jo Allah ka dar rakhte hain.
ayahs.7: Jin logon ko hamare paas aane ka yaqeen nahi hai aur woh dunyavi zindagi par raazi ho gaye hain aur us mein ji laga baithe hain aur jo log hamari aayaton se ghafil hain.
ayahs.8: Aise logon ka thikana un ke aamaal ki wajah se dozakh hai.
ayahs.9: Yaqeenan jo log imaan laaye aur unhon ne nek kaam kiye un ka Rabb un ko un ke imaan ke sabab un ke maqsad tak pahuncha dega nemat ke baghon mein jin ke neeche nahren jaari hongi.
ayahs.10: Un ke munh se yeh baat niklegi Subhan Allah aur un ka bahami salaam yeh hoga assalamu alaikum aur un ki aakhir baat yeh hogi tamam taareefen Allah ke liye hain jo saare jahan ka Rabb hai.
ayahs.11: Aur agar Allah logon par jaldi se nuqsaan waqe kar diya karta jis tarah woh faaida ke liye jaldi machate hain to un ka wada kabhi ka poora ho chuka hota. So hum un logon ko jin ko hamare paas aane ka yaqeen nahi hai un ke haal par chhode rakhte hain ke apni sarkashi mein bhatakte rahen.
ayahs.12: Aur jab insan ko koi takleef pahunchti hai to hum ko pukarta hai lete bhi, baithe bhi, khade bhi. Phir jab hum us ki takleef us se hata dete hain to woh aisa ho jata hai ke goya us ne apni takleef ke liye jo use pahunchi thi kabhi hamein pukara hi na tha, in hadd se guzarne walon ke aamaal ko un ke liye isi tarah khushnuma bana diya gaya hai.
ayahs.13: Aur hum ne tum se pehle bahut se girohon ko halaak kar diya jab ke unhon ne zulm kiya haalaanke un ke paas un ke paighambar bhi dalail le kar aaye, aur woh aise kab the ke imaan le aate? Hum mujrim logon ko aisi hi saza diya karte hain.
ayahs.14: Phir un ke baad hum ne dunya mein bajaye un ke tum ko ja-nasheen kiya taake hum dekh len ke tum kis tarah kaam karte ho.
ayahs.15: Aur jab un ke saamne hamari aayaten padhi jaati hain jo bilkul saaf saaf hain to yeh log jin ko hamare paas aane ki umeed nahi hai yun kehte hain ke is ke siwa koi doosra Quran laiye ya is mein kuch tarmeem kar dijiye. Aap (sallallahu alaihi wasallam) yun keh dijiye ke mujhe yeh haq nahi ke main apni taraf se is mein tarmeem kar doon bas main to isi ka ittiba karunga jo mere paas wahi ke zariye se pahuncha hai, agar main apne Rabb ki nafarmani karun to main ek bade din ke azaab ka andesha rakhta hoon.
ayahs.16: Aap yun keh dijiye ke agar Allah ko manzoor hota to na to main tum ko woh padh kar sunata aur na Allah Taala tum ko us ki ittila deta kyunke main us se pehle to ek bade hissa-e-umr tak tum mein reh chuka hoon. Phir kya tum aqal nahi rakhte.
ayahs.17: So is shakhs se zyada kaun zaalim hoga jo Allah par jhoot baandhe ya us ki aayaton ko jhoota batlaaye, yaqeenan aise mujrim ko aslan falah na hogi.
ayahs.18: Aur yeh log Allah ke siwa aisi cheezon ki ibaadat karte hain jo na un ko zarar pahuncha saken aur na un ko nafa pahuncha saken aur kehte hain ke yeh Allah ke paas hamare sifarishi hain. Aap keh dijiye ke kya tum Allah ko aisi cheez ki khabar dete ho jo Allah Taala ko maloom nahi, na aasmanon mein aur na zameen mein, woh paak aur bartar hai in logon ke shirk se.
ayahs.19: Aur tamam log ek hi ummat ke the phir unhon ne ikhtilaf paida kar liya aur agar ek baat na hoti jo aap ke Rabb ki taraf se pehle thehr chuki hai to jis cheez mein yeh log ikhtilaf kar rahe hain un ka qatai faisla ho chuka hota.
ayahs.20: Aur yeh log yun kehte hain ke un par un ke Rabb ki jaanib se koi nishani kyun nahi nazil hoti? So aap farma dijiye ke ghaib ki khabar sirf Allah ko hai so tum bhi muntazir raho main bhi tumhare saath muntazir hoon.
ayahs.21: Aur jab hum logon ko is amr ke baad ke un par koi museebat pad chuki ho kisi nemat ka maza chakhwa dete hain to woh foran hi hamari aayaton ke baare mein chaalen chalne lagte hain, aap keh dijiye ke Allah chaal chalne mein tum se zyada tez hai, bilyaqeen hamare farishte tumhari sab chaalon ko likh rahe hain.
ayahs.22: Woh Allah aisa hai ke tum ko khushki aur darya mein chalata hai, yahan tak ke jab tum kashti mein hote ho aur woh kashtiyan logon ko muwafiq hawa ke zariye se le kar chalti hain aur woh log un se khush hote hain un par ek jhonka sakht hawa ka aata hai aur har taraf se un par maujen uthti chali aati hain aur woh samajhte hain ke (bure) aa ghere, (is waqt) sab khaalis aitiqad karke Allah hi ko pukarte hain ke agar tu hum ko is se bacha le to hum zaroor shukr-guzar ban jayenge.
ayahs.23: Phir jab Allah Taala un ko bacha leta hai to foran hi woh zameen mein na-haq sarkashi karne lagte hain aye logo! Yeh tumhari sarkashi tumhare liye wabaal hone wali hai dunyavi zindagi ke (chand) faaide hain, phir hamare paas tum ko aana hai phir hum sab tumhara kiya hua tum ko batla denge.
ayahs.24: Pas dunyavi zindagi ki haalat to aisi hai jaise hum ne aasman se paani barsaya phir us se zameen ki nabatat, jin ko aadmi aur chaupaaye khate hain, khoob gunjaan ho kar nikli. Yahan tak ke jab woh zameen apni raunaq ka poora hissa le chuki aur us ki khoob zebaish ho gayi aur us ke malikon ne samajh liya ke ab hum us par bilkul qaabiz ho chuke to din mein ya raat mein us par hamari taraf se koi hukm (azaab) aa pada so hum ne us ko aisa saaf kar diya ke goya kal woh maujood hi na thi. Hum isi tarah aayaat ko saaf saaf bayaan karte hain aise logon ke liye jo sochte hain.
ayahs.25: Aur Allah Taala salamati ke ghar ki taraf tum ko bulata hai aur jis ko chahta hai raah-e-raast par chalne ki taufeeq deta hai.
ayahs.26: Jin logon ne neki ki hai un ke waste khoobi hai aur mazeed bar-aan bhi aur un ke chehron par na siyahi chhayegi aur na zillat, yeh log jannat mein rehne wale hain woh us mein hamesha rahenge.
ayahs.27: Aur jin logon ne badkaam kiye un ki badi ki saza us ke baraabar milegi aur un ko zillat chhayegi, un ko Allah Taala se koi na bacha sakega. Goya un ke chehron par andheri raat ke parat ke parat lapet diye gaye hain. Yeh log dozakh mein rehne wale hain, woh us mein hamesha rahenge.
ayahs.28: Aur woh din bhi qabil-e-zikr hai jis roz hum un sab ko jama karenge phir mushrikon se kahenge ke tum aur tumhare shareek apni jagah thehro phir hum un ke aapas mein phoot daal denge aur un ke woh shuraka kahenge ke tum hamari ibaadat nahi karte the.
ayahs.29: So hamare tumhare darmiyan Allah kaafi hai gawah ke taur par, ke hum ko tumhari ibaadat ki khabar bhi na thi.
ayahs.30: Is maqam par har shakhs apne agle kiye hue kaamon ki jaanch kar lega aur yeh log Allah ki taraf jo un ka Maalik-e-haqeeqi hai lautaye jayenge aur jo kuch jhoot baandha karte the sab un se ghaib ho jayenge.
ayahs.31: Aap kahiye ke woh kaun hai jo tum ko aasman aur zameen se rizq pahunchata hai ya woh kaun hai jo kaanon aur aankhon par poora ikhtiyar rakhta hai aur woh kaun hai jo zinda ko murda se nikalta hai aur murda ko zinda se nikalta hai aur woh kaun hai jo tamam kaamon ki tadbeer karta hai? Zaroor woh yahi kahenge ke Allah to un se kahiye ke phir kyun nahi darte.
ayahs.32: So yeh hai Allah Taala jo tumhara Rabb-e-haqeeqi hai. Phir haq ke baad aur kya reh gaya bajuz gumraahi ke, phir kahaan phire jaate ho?
ayahs.33: Isi tarah aap ke Rabb ki yeh baat ke yeh imaan na layenge, tamam faasiq logon ke haq mein sabit ho chuki hai.
ayahs.34: Aap yun kahiye ke kya tumhare shuraka mein koi aisa hai jo pehli baar bhi paida kare, phir dobara bhi paida kare? Aap keh dijiye ke Allah hi pehli baar paida karta hai phir wohi dobara bhi paida karega. Phir tum kahaan phire jaate ho?
ayahs.35: Aap kahiye ke tumhare shuraka mein koi aisa hai ke haq ka raasta batata ho? Aap keh dijiye ke Allah hi haq ka raasta batata hai. To phir aaya jo shakhs haq ka raasta batata ho woh zyada ittiba ke laiq hai ya woh shakhs jis ko baghair bataye khud hi raasta na soojhe? Pas tum ko kya ho gaya hai tum kaise faisle karte ho.
ayahs.36: Aur un mein se aksar log sirf gumaan par chal rahe hain. Yaqeenan gumaan, haq (ki marifat) mein kuch bhi kaam nahi de sakta yeh jo kuch kar rahe hain yaqeenan Allah ko sab khabar hai.
ayahs.37: Aur yeh Quran aisa nahi hai ke Allah (ki wahi) ke baghair (apne hi se) ghad liya gaya ho. Balke yeh to (un kitabon ki) tasdeeq karne wala hai jo is ke qabl (nazil) ho chuki hain aur kitab (ahkam-e-zarooriya) ki tafseel bayan karne wala hai is mein koi baat shak ki nahi ke Rabb-ul-aalameen ki taraf se hai.
ayahs.38: Kya yeh log yun kehte hain ke aap ne is ko ghad liya hai? Aap keh dijiye ke to phir tum is ke misl ek hi soorat lao aur jin jin ghairullah ko bula sako, bula lo agar tum sachche ho.
ayahs.39: Balke aisi cheez ki takzeeb karne lage jis ko apne ihata-e-ilmi mein nahi laaye aur hanooz un ko is ka aakhir nateeja nahi mila. Jo log un se pehle hue hain isi tarah unhon ne bhi jhutlaya tha, so dekh lijiye un zaalimon ka anjam kaisa hua?
ayahs.40: Aur un mein se baaz aise hain jo is par imaan le aayenge aur baaz aise hain ke is par imaan na layenge. Aur aap ka Rabb mufsidon ko khoob jaanta hai.
ayahs.41: Aur agar aap ko jhutlate rahen to yeh keh dijiye ke mere liye mera amal aur tumhare liye tumhara amal, tum mere amal se bari ho aur main tumhare amal se bari hoon.
ayahs.42: Aur un mein baaz aise hain jo aap ki taraf kaan lagaye baithe hain. Kya aap behron ko sunate hain go un ko samajh bhi na ho?
ayahs.43: Aur un mein baaz aise hain ke aap ko tak rahe hain. Phir kya aap andhon ko raasta dikhlana chahte hain go un ko baseerat bhi na ho?
ayahs.44: Yeh yaqini baat hai ke Allah logon par kuch zulm nahi karta lekin log khud hi apni jaanon par zulm karte hain.
ayahs.45: Aur un ko woh din yaad dilaiye jis mein Allah un ko (apne huzoor) jama karega (to un ko aisa mehsoos hoga) ke goya woh (dunya mein) saare din ki ek aadh ghadi rahe honge aur aapas mein ek doosre ko pehchanne ko thehre honge. Waqai khasare mein pade woh log jinhon ne Allah ke paas jaane ko jhutlaya aur woh hidayat paane wale na the.
ayahs.46: Aur jis ka un se hum waada kar rahe hain is mein se kuch thoda sa agar hum aap ko dikhla den ya (un ke zuhoor se pehle) hum aap ko wafat de den, so hamare paas to un ko aana hi hai. Phir Allah un ke sab afaal par gawah hai.
ayahs.47: Aur har ummat ke liye ek Rasool hai, so jab un ka woh Rasool aa chukta hai un ka faisla insaf ke saath kiya jaata hai, aur un par zulm nahi kiya jaata.
ayahs.48: Aur yeh log kehte hain ke yeh waada kab hoga? Agar tum sachche ho.
ayahs.49: Aap farma dijiye ke main apni zaat ke liye to kisi nafa ka aur kisi zarar ka ikhtiyar rakhta hi nahi magar jitna Allah ko manzoor ho. Har ummat ke liye ek muayyan waqt hai jab un ka woh muayyan waqt aa pahunchta hai to ek ghadi na peechhe hat sakte hain aur na aage sarak sakte hain.
ayahs.50: Aap farma dijiye ke yeh to batlao ke agar tum par Allah ka azaab raat ko aa pade ya din ko to azaab mein kaun si cheez aisi hai ke mujrim log is ko jaldi maang rahe hain.
ayahs.51: Kya phir jab woh aa hi padega is par imaan laoge. Haan ab maana! Haalaanke tum is ki jaldi machaya karte the.
ayahs.52: Phir zaalimon se kaha jayega ke hamesha ka azaab chakho. Tum ko to tumhare kiye ka hi badla mila hai.
ayahs.53: Aur woh aap se daryaft karte hain ke kya azaab waqai sach hai? Aap farma dijiye ke haan qasam hai mere Rabb ki woh waqai sach hai aur tum kisi tarah Allah ko aajiz nahi kar sakte.
ayahs.54: Aur agar har jaan, jis ne zulm (shirk) kiya hai, ke paas itna ho ke saari zameen bhar jaaye tab bhi is ko de kar apni jaan bachane lage aur jab azaab ko dekhenge to pashemani ko posheeda rakhenge. Aur un ka faisla insaf ke saath hoga. Aur un par zulm na hoga.
ayahs.55: Yaad rakho ke jitni cheezen aasmaanon mein aur zameen mein hain sab Allah hi ki milk hain. Yaad rakho ke Allah Taala ka wada sachcha hai lekin bahut se aadmi ilm hi nahi rakhte.
ayahs.56: Wahi jaan daalta hai wahi jaan nikaalta hai aur tum sab usi ke paas laaye jaao ge.
ayahs.57: Aye logo! Tumhare paas tumhare Rabb ki taraf se ek aisi cheez aayi hai jo naseehat hai aur dilon mein jo rog hain un ke liye shifa hai aur rehnumaai karne wali hai aur rehmat hai imaan walon ke liye.
ayahs.58: Aap keh dijiye ke bas logon ko Allah ke is inaam aur rehmat par khush hona chaahiye. Woh is se badarja behtar hai jis ko woh jama kar rahe hain.
ayahs.59: Aap kahiye ke yeh to bataao ke Allah ne tumhare liye jo kuch rizq bheja tha phir tum ne us ka kuch hissa haraam aur kuch halaal qaraar de liya. Aap poochhiye ke kya tum ko Allah ne hukm diya tha ya Allah par iftira hi karte ho?
ayahs.60: Aur jo log Allah par jhoot iftira baandhte hain un ka qayamat ki nisbat kya gumaan hai? Waaqai logon par Allah Taala ka bada hi fazl hai lekin aksar aadmi shukr nahi karte.
ayahs.61: Aur aap kisi haal mein hon aur minjumla in ahwaal ke aap kahin se Quran padhte hon aur jo kaam bhi karte hon hum ko sab ki khabar rehti hai jab tum us kaam mein mashghool hote ho. Aur aap ke Rabb se koi cheez zarra baraabar bhi ghaib nahi na zameen mein aur na aasmaan mein aur na koi cheez us se chhoti aur na koi cheez badi magar yeh sab kitaab-e-mubeen mein hai.
ayahs.62: Yaad rakho Allah ke doston par na koi andesha hai aur na woh ghamgeen hote hain.
ayahs.63: Yeh woh log hain jo imaan laaye aur (buraiyon se) parhez rakhte hain.
ayahs.64: Un ke liye dunyavi zindagi mein bhi aur aakhirat mein bhi khushkhabri hai Allah Taala ki baaton mein kuch farq hua nahi karta. Yeh badi kaamyaabi hai.
ayahs.65: Aur aap ko un ki baaten gham mein na daalen. Tamaam tar ghalba Allah hi ke liye hai woh sunta jaanta hai.
ayahs.66: Yaad rakho ke jitne kuch aasmaanon mein hain aur jitne zameen mein hain yeh sab Allah hi ke hain aur jo log Allah ko chhod kar doosre shuraka ki ibaadat kar rahe hain kis cheez ki ittebaa kar rahe hain. Mehaz be-sanad khayaal ki ittebaa kar rahe hain aur mehaz atkalain laga rahe hain.
ayahs.67: Woh aisa hai jis ne tumhare liye raat banaayi taake tum us mein aaraam karo aur din bhi is taur par banaaya ke dekhne bhaalne ka zariya hai, tahqeeq is mein dalail hain un logon ke liye jo sunte hain.
ayahs.68: Woh kehte hain ke Allah aulaad rakhta hai. Subhan Allah! Woh to kisi ka mohtaaj nahi usi ki milkiyat hai jo kuch aasmaanon mein hai aur jo kuch zameen mein hai. Tumhare paas is par koi daleel nahi. Kya Allah ke zimme aisi baat lagaate ho jis ka tum ilm nahi rakhte.
ayahs.69: Aap keh dijiye ke jo log Allah par jhoot iftira karte hain, woh kaamyaab na honge.
ayahs.70: Yeh dunya mein thoda sa aish hai phir hamare paas un ko aana hai phir hum un ko un ke kufr ke badle sakht azaab chakhayenge.
ayahs.71: Aur aap un ko Nooh (alaihis salaam) ka qissa padh kar sunaaiye jab ke unhon ne apni qaum se farmaaya ke aye meri qaum! Agar tum ko mera rehna aur ahkaam-e-Ilahi ki naseehat karna bhaari maloom hota hai to mera to Allah hi par bharosa hai. Tum apni tadbeer ma apne shuraka ke pukhta karlo phir tumhari tadbeer tumhari ghutan ka baais na honi chaahiye. Phir mere saath kar guzro aur mujh ko mohlat na do.
ayahs.72: Phir bhi agar tum airaaz hi kiye jaao to main ne tum se koi muawaza to nahi maanga, mera muawaza to sirf Allah hi ke zimme hai aur mujh ko hukm kiya gaya hai ke main musalmaanon mein se rahoon.
ayahs.73: So woh log un ko jhutlaate rahe pas hum ne un ko aur jo un ke saath kashti mein the un ko najaat di aur un ko jaanasheen banaaya aur jinhon ne hamari aayaton ko jhutlaaya tha un ko gharq kar diya. So dekhna chaahiye kaisa anjaam hua un logon ka jo daraaye ja chuke the.
ayahs.74: Phir Nooh (alaihis salaam) ke baad hum ne aur Rasoolon ko un ki qaumon ki taraf bheja so woh un ke paas roshan daleelen le kar aaye pas jis cheez ko unhon ne awwal mein jhoota keh diya yeh na hua ke phir us ko maan lete. Allah Taala isi tarah hadd se badhne walon ke dilon par band laga deta hai.
ayahs.75: Phir in paighambaron ke baad hum ne Moosa aur Haaroon (alaihimas-salaam) ko, Firaun aur us ke sardaron ke paas apni nishaaniyaan de kar bheja. So unhon ne takabbur kiya aur woh log mujrim qaum the.
ayahs.76: Phir jab un ko hamare paas se saheeh daleel pahunchi to woh log kehne lage ke yaqeenan yeh sareeh jaadu hai.
ayahs.77: Moosa (alaihis salaam) ne farmaaya ke kya tum is saheeh daleel ki nisbat jab ke woh tumhare paas pahunchi aisi baat kehte ho kya yeh jaadu hai, haalaanke jaadugar kaamyaab nahi hua karte.
ayahs.78: Woh log kehne lage kya tum hamare paas is liye aaye ho ke hum ko us tareeqa se hata do jis par hum ne apne baap daadon ko paaya hai aur tum dono ko dunya mein badaai mil jaaye aur hum tum dono ko kabhi na maanenge.
ayahs.79: Aur Firaun ne kaha ke mere paas tamaam maahir jaadugaron ko haazir karo.
ayahs.80: Phir jab jaadugar aaye to Moosa (alaihis salaam) ne un se farmaaya ke daalo jo kuch tum daalne wale ho.
ayahs.81: So jab unhon ne daala to Moosa (alaihis salaam) ne farmaaya ke yeh jo kuch tum laaye ho jaadu hai. Yaqeeni baat hai ke Allah is ko abhi darham-barham kiye deta hai, Allah aise fasaadiyon ka kaam banne nahi deta.
ayahs.82: Aur Allah Taala haq ko apne farmaan se saabit kar deta hai go mujrim kaisa hi naagawaar samjhen.
ayahs.83: Pas Moosa (alaihis salaam) par un ki qaum mein se sirf qadre qaleel aadmi iman laye woh bhi Firaun se aur apne hukkam se darte darte ke kahin un ko takleef pahunchaye aur waqai mein Firaun is mulk mein zor rakhta tha, aur yeh bhi baat thi ke woh had se bahar ho jata tha.
ayahs.84: Aur Moosa (alaihis salaam) ne farmaya ke ae meri qaum! Agar tum Allah par iman rakhte ho to isi par tawakkul karo agar tum musalman ho.
ayahs.85: Unhon ne arz kiya ke hum ne Allah hi par tawakkul kiya. Ae hamare Parwardigar! Hum ko un zaalimon ke liye fitna na bana.
ayahs.86: Aur hum ko apni rahmat se un kafir logon se najat de.
ayahs.87: Aur hum ne Moosa (alaihis salaam) aur un ke bhai ke paas wahi bheji ke tum donon apne un logon ke liye Misr mein ghar barqarar rakho aur tum sab apne inhi gharon ko namaz padhne ki jagah qarar de lo aur namaz ke paband raho aur aap musalmanon ko basharat de den.
ayahs.88: Aur Moosa (alaihis salaam) ne arz kiya ae hamare Rab! Tu ne Firaun ko aur is ke sardaron ko saman-e-zeenat aur tarah tarah ke maal dunyavi zindagi mein diye. Ae hamare Rab! (isi waste diye hain ke) woh teri raah se gumrah karen. Ae hamare Rab! Un ke maalon ko neest-o-nabood kar de aur un ke dilon ko sakht kar de so yeh iman na lane payen yahan tak ke dardnak azaab ko dekh len.
ayahs.89: Haq Taala ne farmaya ke tum donon ki dua qabool kar li gayi, so tum sabit-qadam raho aur un logon ki raah na chalna jin ko ilm nahin.
ayahs.90: Aur hum ne Bani Israel ko darya se paar kar diya phir un ke peechhe peechhe Firaun apne lashkar ke saath zulm aur ziyadati ke irade se chala yahan tak ke jab doobne laga to kehne laga ke main iman lata hoon ke jis par Bani Israel iman laye hain, is ke siwa koi mabood nahin aur main musalmanon mein se hoon.
ayahs.91: (Jawab diya gaya ke) ab iman lata hai? Aur pehle sarkashi karta raha aur mufsidon mein dakhil raha.
ayahs.92: So aaj hum sirf teri laash ko najat denge taake to un ke liye nishan-e-ibrat ho jo tere baad hain aur haqeeqat yeh hai ke bahut se aadmi hamari nishaniyon se ghafil hain.
ayahs.93: Aur hum ne Bani Israel ko bahut achchha thikana rehne ko diya aur hum ne inhen pakeeza cheezen khane ko din. So unhon ne ikhtilaf nahin kiya yahan tak ke un ke paas ilm pahunch gaya. Yaqeeni baat hai ke aap ka Rab un ke darmiyan qayamat ke din un umoor mein faisla karega jin mein woh ikhtilaf karte the.
ayahs.94: Phir agar aap is ki taraf se shak mein hon jis ko hum ne aap ke paas bheja hai to aap un logon se poochh dekhiye jo aap se pehli kitabon ko padhte hain. Be-shak aap ke paas aap ke Rab ki taraf se sachchi kitab aayi hai. Aap hargiz shak karne walon mein se na hon.
ayahs.95: Aur na un logon mein se hon jinhon ne Allah Taala ki aayaton ko jhutlaya, kahin aap khasara pane walon mein se na ho jayen.
ayahs.96: Yaqeenan jin logon ke haq mein aap ke Rab ki baat sabit ho chuki hai woh iman na layenge.
ayahs.97: Go un ke paas tamam nishaniyan pahunch jayen jab tak ke woh dardnak azaab ko na dekh len.
ayahs.98: Chunanche koi basti iman na layi ke iman lana is ko nafa hota siwaye Yunus (alaihis salaam) ki qaum ke. Jab woh iman le aaye to hum ne ruswai ke azaab ko dunyavi zindagi mein un par se taal diya aur un ko ek waqt (khas) tak ke liye zindagi se faida uthane (ka mauqa) diya.
ayahs.99: Aur agar aap ka Rab chahta to tamam roo-e-zameen ke log sab ke sab iman le aate, to kya aap logon par zabardasti kar sakte hain yahan tak ke woh momin hi ho jayen.
ayahs.100: Halanke kisi shakhs ka iman lana Allah ke hukm ke baghair mumkin nahin. Aur Allah Taala be-aql logon par gandagi daal deta hai.
ayahs.101: Aap keh dijiye ke tum ghaur karo ke kya kya cheezen aasmanon mein aur zameen mein hain aur jo log iman nahin late un ko nishaniyan aur dhamkiyan kuch faida nahin pahunchatin.
ayahs.102: So woh log sirf un logon ke se waqiat ka intezar kar rahe hain jo un se pehle guzar chuke hain. Aap farma dijiye ke achchha to tum intezar mein raho main bhi tumhare saath intezar karne walon mein hoon.
ayahs.103: Phir hum apne paighambaron ko aur iman walon ko bacha lete the, isi tarah hamare zimma hai ke hum iman walon ko najat diya karte hain.
ayahs.104: Aap keh dijiye ke ae logo! Agar tum mere deen ki taraf se shak mein ho to main un maboodon ki ibaadat nahin karta jin ki tum Allah ko chhod kar ibaadat karte ho, lekin haan is Allah ki ibaadat karta hoon jo tumhari jaan qabz karta hai. Aur mujh ko yeh hukm hua hai ke main iman lane walon mein se hoon.
ayahs.105: Aur yeh ke apna rukh yaksu ho kar (is) deen ki taraf kar lena, aur kabhi mushrikon mein se na hona.
ayahs.106: Aur Allah ko chhod kar aisi cheez ki ibaadat mat karna jo tujh ko na koi nafa pahunchaa sake aur na koi zarar pahunchaa sake. Phir agar aisa kiya to tum is halat mein zaalimon mein se ho jaoge.
ayahs.107: Aur agar tum ko Allah koi takleef pahunchaye to bajuz is ke aur koi is ko door karne wala nahin hai aur agar woh tum ko koi khair pahunchana chahe to is ke fazl ka koi hatane wala nahin, woh apna fazl apne bandon mein se jis par chahe nichhawar kar de aur woh badi maghfirat badi rahmat wala hai.
ayahs.108: Aap keh dijiye ke ae logo! Tumhare paas haq tumhare Rab ki taraf se pahunch chuka hai, is liye jo shakhs raah-e-rast par aa jaye so woh apne waste raah-e-rast par aayega aur jo shakhs be-raah rahega to is ka be-raah hona isi par padega aur main tum par musallat nahin kiya gaya.
ayahs.109: Aur aap is ki ittiba karte rahiye jo kuch aap ke paas wahi bheji jati hai aur sabr kijiye yahan tak ke Allah faisla kar de aur woh sab faisla karne walon mein achchha hai.
